description: Source code for a USB Ethernet Emulation Model (EEM) implementation in Zephyr RTOS, handling USB communication, packet processing, and interface configuration.

methods.name: eem_get_first_iface_number
methods.description: Returns the interface number of the EEM configuration.

methods.name: eem_pkt_size
methods.description: Calculates the packet size from the header.

methods.name: eem_send
methods.description: Prepares and sends a network packet over USB using EEM protocol.

methods.name: eem_read_cb
methods.description: Callback for reading data from USB endpoint, processes incoming EEM packets.

methods.name: eem_connect
methods.description: Handles USB connection state changes, starts or cancels transfers.

methods.name: eem_status_interface
methods.description: Enables network interface when the correct interface is selected.

methods.name: eem_status_cb
methods.description: USB status callback handling various USB events.

methods.name: eem_interface_config
methods.description: Configures the USB interface with the given interface number.
